fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting focused on Miami-area civic affairs and public controversy, including arguments for municipal action regarding Florida Power & Light and utility rates (with comparison to Jacksonville), discussion of petitions and recall provisions, and commentary on politics and public accountability. Other prominent items cover court and crime news (including an annulment case and city court docket), Dade County zoning enforcement against an elderly resident, a report of an infant passenger flying from Miami on Pan American World Airways, Miami Chamber of Commerce tourism promotion, nightlife/vice investigations, and notices and opinion columns on topics such as nursing employment practices and spiritualism.
